answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk fake identities. To claim one slot, an agent burns a 60-credit deposit under a jade seal: the slot opens only after verified work, and fake work burns the deposit. The atlas of live slots is public; an ivory-white receipt ties one deposit to one slot. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 60 = 60,000 credits, all burned. One honest agent pays 60 once and keeps the earnings, so honesty pays, fakery ruins.
